annotation.title_clean: Prime Minister's Order No 009/03 of 07/02/2024 determining organisational structure of Rwanda Information Society Authority
annotation.title_en: Prime Minister's Order No 009/03 of 07/02/2024 determining organisational structure of Rwanda Information Society Authority
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Prime Minister's Office, Republic of Rwanda
annotation.venue: Official Gazette of the Republic of Rwanda, Special of 08/02/2024
annotation.summary_en: Rwandan Prime Minister's Order (trilingual) setting the organisational structure and staffing positions of the Rwanda Information Society Authority (RISA), repealing the 2020 order. It contains no AI or robotics governance content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Annex sets RISA's organisational structure and posts.
Salaries follow the structure approved by Cabinet on 20/10/2023.
Repeals Prime Minister's Order No 095/03 of 14/08/2020.
Enters into force on publication in the Official Gazette.
